changelog: Q3Elite Launcher v0.2 — Performance & Feature Update
This release focuses on performance improvements, stability, and expanding the launcher's functionality.
Optimized UI rendering and reduced unnecessary widget updates.
Improved loading times when opening sections with large amounts of data.
Implemented image caching to avoid repeatedly downloading and decoding assets.
Optimized levelshot loading for Servers, Maps, and Demos.
Improved table construction and data processing.
Enhanced screenshot browsing with native 16:9 image presentation.
Added smoother navigation and improved interaction responsiveness.
Improved Home section image carousel with automatic scrolling and transitions.
Enhanced Telegram changelog rendering and custom emoji support.
Refined audio handling to reduce unnecessary processing during rapid navigation.
Improved account management and backend configuration recovery.
Enhanced Repair functionality to detect and restore missing or corrupted launcher files.
Various UI refinements, bug fixes, and stability improvements.
A more responsive, polished, and reliable Q3Elite Launcher experience.
